title: Nonspecific vs. specific DNA binding free energetics of a transcription factor domain protein.
authors: Al Masri, Carmen; Wan, Biao; Yu, Jin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟和随机动力学建模，系统研究了转录因子结构域蛋白在非特异与特异DNA结合间的自由能差异及取向切换机制，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Transcription factor (TF) proteins regulate gene expression by binding to specific sites on the genome. In the facilitated diffusion model, an optimized search process is achieved by the TF alternating between 3D diffusion in the bulk and 1D diffusion along DNA. While undergoing 1D diffusion, the protein can switch from a search mode for fast diffusion along nonspecific DNA to a recognition mode for stable binding to specific DNA. It was recently noticed that, for a small TF domain protein, reorientations on DNA happen between the nonspecific and specific DNA binding. We here conducted all-atom molecular dynamics simulations with steering forces to reveal the protein-DNA binding free energetics, confirming that the search and recognition modes are distinguished primarily by protein orientations on the DNA. As the binding free energy difference between the specific and nonspecific DNA system slightly deviates from that being estimated directly from dissociation constants on 15-bp DNA constructs, we hypothesize that the discrepancy can come from DNA sequences flanking the 6-bp central binding sites that impact on the dissociation kinetics measurements. The hypothesis is supported by a simplified spherical protein-DNA model along with stochastic simulations and kinetic modeling.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TF）蛋白通过结合基因组上的特定位点来调控基因表达。在促进扩散模型中，优化搜索过程通过TF在体相中的三维扩散与沿DNA的一维扩散之间交替实现。在一维扩散过程中，蛋白可以从沿非特异性DNA快速扩散的搜索模式切换到与特异性DNA稳定结合的识别模式。最近注意到，对于小型TF结构域蛋白，在非特异性和特异性DNA结合之间会发生DNA上的重新定向。我们在此进行了带引导力的全原子分子动力学模拟，以揭示蛋白-DNA结合的自由能学，确认搜索模式和识别模式主要依据蛋白在DNA上的取向来区分。由于特异性与非特异性DNA系统之间的结合自由能差异与直接从15-bp DNA构建体上的解离常数估算的值略有偏差，我们假设这种差异可能源于影响解离动力学测量的6-bp中心结合位点侧翼的DNA序列。该假设得到了简化球形蛋白-DNA模型以及随机模拟和动力学建模的支持。
